test_gtn_equal: test two gtn graphs for structural equality including nodes, arcs, labels, and weights
test_gtn_isomorphic: test whether two gtn graphs are isomorphic ignoring node ordering but preserving structure
test_gtn_loadtxt: test loading a gtn graph from a text file and verify it matches the expected graph
test_gtn_savetxt: test saving a gtn graph to a text file and verify the output format is correct
test_gtn_loadsave: test saving and loading a gtn graph to and from a binary file for roundtrip verification
